units.source_text: 这花名只有你这博士知道了！”

en.t: Only a scholar like you would know the name of this flower!

units.source_text: 这寥寥数字，在夕雾看来是极有风韵的答书。

en.t: These few words seemed to Yugiri to be an exceptionally charming reply.

units.source_text: 此后他依然不忘情于这藤典侍，常常偷偷地和她约会。

en.t: After that, he still could not forget this Fuji lady-in-waiting and often met her secretly.
